lessonGrammar.name: 介词短语作定语
lessonGrammar.note: behind his answer 修饰 method。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: In our preparation group, we may analyse one reading passage every day, and each member may share the method behind his answer.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 在我们的备考小组里,我们可能每天分析一篇阅读文章,而每个成员都可以分享他答案背后的方法。

lessonGrammar.name: learn not to do
lessonGrammar.note: learn not to do sth 表示「学会不做某事」。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: A question on the main idea may require a general view, and we learn not to generalise from one detail or a single paragraph.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 主旨题可能要求宏观的视野,而我们要学会不从一两个细节或单个段落就做出概括。

lessonGrammar.name: 阅读方法论
lessonGrammar.note: 主旨题忌以偏概全,应看整体(general view),是本单元阅读题型方法的核心。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: A question on the main idea may require a general view, and we learn not to generalise from one detail or a single paragraph.

lessonGrammar.name: point to
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: A question on detail may point to a specific line, yet the wrong option may repeat the word of that line with a small change, and such a trap may waste our time; we may identify the culprit of a wrong answer before we move on, and this step may turn a mistake into a lesson.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 细节题可能指向某一具体行,但错误选项可能对那一行的词作一点小改动后重复使用,这样的陷阱会浪费我们的时间。; 我们可能会在继续之前找出错误答案的元凶,而这一步能把错误变成教训。
